runs.reason: Ran to the configured EOD flatten time with zero tick failures after the crash fix. Session-readiness state does not persist across a process restart (SessionReadinessValidator is in-memory only, unlike lifecycle_state.json) -- restarting after 10:00 ET meant this run's own readiness finalization had zero opening-minute observations for every symbol, so all 35 were DATA_NOT_READY for this run despite 35/35 warmup readiness. Natural strategy decisions were therefore structurally unavailable this run through no fault of the decision path itself. The predeclared 15:00 ET PIV_LIFECYCLE_PROBE fallback fired exactly as designed and exercised the full order lifecycle.

known_limitation_discovered: SessionReadinessValidator state is in-memory only and does not survive a process restart. A restart after 10:00 ET (as happened today, forced by the run-1 crash) causes every symbol to appear DATA_NOT_READY for the remainder of that session's restarted process, even if the original opening data was fine. Recommended follow-up: persist readiness state to disk (same pattern lifecycle_state.json already uses) or document that a restart should only be attempted before 10:00 ET.
